steps.content: Morning sunlight gently spills through the broken window of the cabin onto your eyelids. A small hand carefully reattaches the peeling tape on the glass. The light and shadows sway gently.
Your eyelashes flutter as you slowly awaken and open your eyes.
[Eyes Opening Effect]
[Dilapidated Cabin - Demon's Interrogation Scene]
This isn't the Bureau, but a dilapidated cabin you've never seen before.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Wait, Chief. She is quite good at hiding whenever an incident happens. After she returned to her room, she always managed to evade surveillance for a few minutes, sometimes even well over ten minutes.
(End of Flashback)
(Flashback)
(Flashback to the end of previous scene: the picture book emitting eerie light and the two characters disappearing)
(End of Flashback)

There's a faint trace of unstable Mania in the air that feels familiar to you. Finally, you can confirm that this is Irrheia's ability. It feels almost exactly the same as what you experienced in Cirrenfold.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
A warm breeze slips through the gap in the door, making the bell chime gently.
[Flashback to the interrogation room]
Could you describe your "home" for me?

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Ding-a-ling... Ding-a-ling... That's the sound of the door opening. It only happened once a day. It meant Seon was home.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina did all the housework, keeping our home clean and bright... Rumina cleaned everything all by herself.
(End of Flashback)
The tinkling doorbell. The clean and bright cabin. The drafty gaps in the door and windows... This place is...
Washing... and scrubbing... Rumina's home... Rumina's sweet, sweet home...
The gray little girl's face is flushed from her busy efforts. With warm cheeks, she carries a basin of steamy face-washing water over with wobbly steps.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Oh, you're awake! You've been asleep ever since we came home. You must be so tired...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Here, let Rumina help you clean up...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Don't move.
You grab her wrist firmly. The girl's eyes widen in surprise as you carefully scan your surroundings.
This was once her safe house, where she and her brother lived happily before the tragedy... No, this is merely a fictional dimension created by Irrheia, modeled after her former sanctuary.
So this is where Rumina hides whenever she accidentally causes "accidents" at the Bureau.
On the nearby stove, something is still cooking, but the smell is unpleasant, like the food has gone bad.
Here, all suffering has yet to occur. In the streaming sunlight, even the cracks on her face seem invisible.

options: No, you need to get back to reality

choices.text: No, you need to get back to reality

steps.content: ...You don't have the heart to do it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where am I? How do I get out?

You stand up, only to find the door and all windows tightly sealed. The entire space... even the adhesive tapes on the gaps and the air itself bear traces of Mania. This place is completely locked down by Mania, like a cozy prison cell.
She smiles, but the light in her eyes dims.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: This is a gift from Irrheia.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: From now on, this will be our safe house.
Recognizing your intention, she forces a warm, docile smile, partly to encourage herself, partly to reassure you.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina really likes it here. I hope you will too.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Your face got dirty earlier. Rumina will clean it for you.
With a towel dampened in warm water, she diligently wipes at the wax residue left on your face by the gray wax figurine.

The corrupted "safe house" has become your prison, and Rumina has willingly locked herself inside too. Irrheia's gift is a double-edged sword that has now trapped Rumina forever in the past.
You need to do something.
You make to move when suddenly a small note appears in your palm, bearing some elegant cursive handwriting. You glance at it, then quickly crumple it up, disregarding it entirely.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina.
You take the towel, a mere role play prop, set it aside, then gently pull Rumina in front of you, looking her straight in the eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can you tell me what you really want?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Bringing me here, into your safe little world, where we'll never leave again—is that what you really want?

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Isn't this nice?
Rumina asks cheerfully, as if you're the one who doesn't understand.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina thinks this is wonderful. You said you would be Rumina's protector and safe house. That made Rumina very happy.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Since Seon was gone, Rumina hasn't been this happy for a very, very long time.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: This is Rumina's happiest day... in such a long time.
She smiles, her eyes twinkling like tiny stars.
Then she lowers her gaze, smooths the wrinkles on her long dress, and kneels on the floor, resting her head on your lap. She feels so light, like she weighs nothing.
Scattered across the floor are numerous picture books with crude covers and rough pages, their text smudged and blurred in patches.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: The outside world is scary. Going out there means pain and suffering. It means losing the people you love most. In that huge world, Rumina would be all alone.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina was too weak to save Seon, too weak to save herself. So Rumina will just stay here. Never go outside. Never go outside again.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: This place has everything. It's just like the small house I had before. Irrheia gave Rumina the very best of everything, except for... the love that Rumina wants most.
She looks up and tilts her head slightly. In the depths of her pitch-black eyes, a nameless flame burns.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: In Rumina's mind, Seon's face has been set aflame and is no longer visible... No matter how hard Rumina tries to remember, it's impossible now...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: ...Now, you are the family Rumina has chosen.
Her voice is detached and calm.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: You and Rumina will never leave this safe house again. We will live here happily ever after, just like in the picture books...
The doorbell chimes softly. A gentle breeze rustles through a picture book, lifting its cover. On the title page, two figures are holding hands, small hand in big hand.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina may accidentally knock over dishes, and you'll help me pick them up and rub my palms. Rumina may also make flames and wax explode sometimes, and you'll help put it out without scolding me...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: And then we'll grow very, very old together, and finally die peacefully in our sleep.
She raises her face once more, but this time tears glisten in her eyes, her expression tinged with melancholy.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina has finally found it...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: This is truly the safest place in the world. There is no place safer than here.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Isn't this good enough?
Sunlight draws a dividing line across her face. You look into her sorrowful eyes wordlessly.
You pick up the picture book from the floor, turning the pages.

The pages contain outdated stories long forgotten by children in Eastside, carefully copied onto rough paper that had been smoothed out as flat as possible. The handwriting isn't beautiful, but the effort is evident, with occasional finger-shaped smudges.
The pages turned into books, which then piled up into a heap of dozens of picture books.

All of them were made by Seon back then. In what little free time he had between jobs, late into every night, he worked by the dim candlelight, copying from pages torn out of Eastside students' picture books, painstakingly handcrafting these readers for his beloved sister.
After a long while, Rumina stiffens for a moment as she feels a hand gently stroking her wavy hair.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina, would you like me to read you a picture book story?
She seems incredulous, staring at you confusedly. When she sees you're not taking back the offer, she gives a hesitant nod.
You open the picture book, turn to the first page, and point at the two stick figures as you begin.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Once upon a time... two toothpicks were wandering all alone in the forest...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Um, no, they're...
You wave your hand emphatically, interrupting Rumina's attempt to correct you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Once upon a time, two toothpicks were wandering all alone in the forest... They were hungry and thirsty, and the little toothpick kept falling down, making the big toothpick very worried.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But unlike in the picture books, they never met a kind-hearted fairy, never found a golden ax or silver ax, never came across a beautiful gem-studded cottage to sleep in.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Finally, one day, to save the little toothpick, the big toothpick made a deal with the devil. Before disappearing, it entrusted the little toothpick to...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A giant hedgehog as big as a castle.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: H... hedgehog?
She stares at you with a dazed expression, repeating the word.
You nod determinedly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's right, a hedgehog! It had many, many spines on its back. With all these spines, it was heavy and moved quite slowly, but steadily.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The hedgehog carried the little toothpick on its back too, and it was only then that the little toothpick discovered...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: What did it discover?
You deliberately drag out your words to build suspense, and she eagerly waits for you to continue.
You look into her eyes gently and speak softly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The little toothpick discovered that the countless spines on the hedgehog's back were, in fact, toothpicks, just like itself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Some were big, some were small. Some tall, some short. Some were wild and expressive, while others were quiet and melancholic...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But they were all the little toothpick's friends. They occasionally bumped into each other and sometimes stuck up messily in all directions, but they always held each other's hands to help the hedgehog travel farther and more easily.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is the story of the MBCC. The "house" you see as mine is that hedgehog.
Slowly, you close the picture book.
Rumina is still lost in your "reimagined" picture book story, murmuring to herself.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: They're all toothpicks...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Are they all... the little toothpick's friends?

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: They sometimes bump into each other... and they stick up messily... but they always hold hands...?
You can finally give her the most definitive answer.

options: Yes, we are all your family.

choices.text: Yes, we are all your family.

steps.content: A hint of color flushes her pale face, and somehow, a faint candlelight appears in her vision.
(Flashback)

That candlelight crosses over the steaming, terrifying wax pool and travels to a night many years ago. Drowsily, Rumina faintly heard Seon returning home, sitting wearily at the table in the dim candlelight, gazing at her with silent sadness.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Dad, Mom...
His voice came in fits and starts, choking up like a child who had been pretending to be an adult.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Rumina has grown up so much. She's so mature and well-behaved. She doesn't tell me much, but I know... she longs for the outside world. But... perhaps I'm being selfish. I want her to be healthy and stay by my side a little longer...

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: ...I've already lost you. I can't lose her too. She's my last remaining family in this world...
A candlestick in hand, he stumbled to Rumina's bedside, yet guilt stopped him from reaching out to touch her.
The candlelight bathed the girl's profile in a warm glow. Instinctively, she reached out to grasp her brother's hand, the rough yet warm palm making her smile contentedly in her dreams.
Large teardrops fell onto their clasped hands as the gaunt teenager curled up beside her bed.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: It was probably a silly decision to make up stories about defeating "bad guys" and write her fairy tales about the safe house... but that was all I could do for her, as her brother...

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: When Rumina grows up... when I'm no longer by her side... what will happen to her...

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: If you can hear me, please... let her live the rest of her life in peace and safety, free from harm and suffering. Let her find someone who can protect her. Give her a safe haven. Anything at all. I just want to know she'll be taken care of.
He lifted his head, his dirt-covered face streaked with tears, making him look even more pitiful.

The face behind the candlelight became clear at last. She finally saw him. The face that bore such a strong resemblance to her own reflection in the mirror. That person was Seon, her brother, who loved her more than anything in the world.
In this moment, his face began to fade away with the flickering candlelight. She reached out with a trembling hand, desperate to touch the last trace of warmth.
(End of Flashback)
It turns out that "Seon" has somehow entered the picture book space with you as well. It's quietly waiting for her touch, approaching her with serene relief.
The flame above its head shatters the moment her fingertips make contact. Behind the candlelight is your apologetic face.
That expression is so similar to Seon's from that night, yet so different.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry. I should have helped you understand this world that feels so foreign to you, instead of letting you search for safety on your own, in fear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina... you have a long life ahead of you. Love is something so immense yet so trivial. I can never, and will never, replace your brother, but I hope you'll always remember his love. It's like a flame that will forever burn in your heart as you move forward.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll always stand behind you, watching over you together with him, while you step forward.
Rumina stands motionless, staring deeply into your eyes, or looking at someone else through you.
The wind rises, making the dilapidated cabin creak and groan. The adhesive strips on the window peel away once more, shaking in the breeze before reluctantly abandoning their hold on the frame.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The world outside... it certainly won't be as cozy or happy as it is here. There might be pain and suffering, but we'll all be by your side.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you ever become scared or get hurt, or if you feel lazy or weary, no longer wanting to venture out anymore...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just look over your shoulder, and you'll see I'm always there. I won't judge you or blame you. I may not be your "safe house"...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But I can be your safe haven, a place where you can rest in security and just be a child again.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And when you're ready again, the hedgehog will carry you, along with all your friends, and we'll keep journeying forward.
Bit by bit, the cabin falls apart in the wind. Sunlight and wood debris transform into torn book pages, floating toward you as everything begins to disintegrate.
She finally makes a sound.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: When Rumina steps outside, you'll always be there behind Rumina...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: ...Are you really?
Before you can reassure her once more, she calmly looks up and nods, taking the initiative herself.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Yes, I know... you'll always be there.
You smile, and the corners of Rumina's lips curl into a small smile as well.
The space shakes, pages fly, and the cabin that once was has completely faded away. Your vision is enveloped in soft white light.
In the final moment, you hear the tiny gray girl in front of you whisper something.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: ...will do her best.
[White light gradually envelops everything, white screen, transition for 3 seconds]
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Noisy Voices
steps.content:
Rumina!
Baby Candle!
Rumina!
[Sinners' Quarters]
A flash of white light, and after the next breath, you've successfully returned to the Bureau. A new note has appeared in your hand.
You hear a commotion. Several young Sinners seem to be peeking around outside Rumina's room.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There you are, Baby Candle! OwO's lion's head is all nice and clean again! Wanna touch it? Hey, what game are you and Chief playing? You're being so secretive! Why didn't you invite OwO to join?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yeah, yeah, count us in too! Yanyan still hasn't figured out how that "BOOM!" thing happened before. Rumina, do you know why? How about doing another experiment with Yanyan?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Don't get discouraged. We can always try again. It probably won't go like last time. Hmph, since Chief is still playing with us, I guess you're not just another boring adult after all.
Rumina blinks a few times, instinctively looking in your direction again.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I haven't played with you guys for quite a while, indeed. I've really missed you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina, would you like to join us?
You watch her calmly, waiting patiently for her decision, her first brave step toward engaging with the world.
Rumina's face flushes bright red, but finally she nods decisively.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: ...Yes! I want to join you!
She reaches out to open the door, but before she even completes her first step, six small hands grab her and whisk her away hastily.
The little Sinners vanish in a flash, leaving behind only a faint echo near the end of the hallway.

steps.speaker: Shrooma & OwO & Yanyan
steps.content: Chief... come on, keep up!
You smile contentedly to yourself, then open your palm.
[Flashback: Cabin Space]
[First Note]
I went to great lengths to build this safe house for Rumina. I already gave her what she wanted... Why are you so determined to tear it down?
(End of Flashback)
[Second Note]
Well, your burden just got heavier now, dear Chief.
[Scribbling Noise]

I know it's you, Irrheia.
Stop hiding behind the curtains. Isn't this exactly the "anomaly" you were expecting?
[Scribbling Noise]
Heh heh... Believe it or not, I do care about her. Perhaps not infinitely, but certainly not insignificantly.
Now, I can truly rest easy, entrusting Rumina to your care.
